data.one_liner: A customizable button bar with animated selection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a row of buttons that animate when selected. Supports inversion, custom colors, radius, padding and elevation. Allows programmatic index changes via a controller.
use_when: You need a simple selectable button bar with built‑in animation
You want quick visual feedback for tab‑like UI without building it from scratch
avoid_when: You require complex navigation or routing logic
You need a full‑featured tab controller with deep state management
weaknesses: Package version appears outdated in README
